title: Review before publishing
behavior: Never publish a claim without source and review status.
nudge: If no source, the claim stays draft.
whyItMatters: Quality depends on making review visible and routine.

title: Turn concern into a pathway
behavior: Every urgent need should point to at least one responsible action and one learning pathway.
nudge: Homepage prompt asks what someone can do responsibly.
whyItMatters: People need a responsible next step, not only awareness.

title: Show assumptions
behavior: Every scenario displays assumptions, caveats, and what would change the analysis.
nudge: No scenario can appear without caveats.
whyItMatters: Foresight should be inspectable, not mysterious.

title: Practice before acting
behavior: Users should practice through simulations before field-facing action.
nudge: Action pages link to relevant simulations.
whyItMatters: Practice helps reduce harm before action.

title: Make learning social
behavior: Convert individual learning into team, workshop, or campus action lab formats.
nudge: Every learning pathway suggests a group format.

title: Share responsibly
nudge: Every share asset includes prototype and human review language where relevant.
whyItMatters: Diffusion must not distort the method.

title: Protect the vulnerable
behavior: No direct matching with minors or vulnerable people.
nudge: Any youth pathway shows a safeguarding warning.
whyItMatters: Safeguarding is a product requirement, not a footer.
